{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcriYh2pWed61LLQ3UH7p","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019rrMeXYiWDjsT1Aa646cqz","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nr = pd.read_csv('readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\ns = pd.read_csv('stations.csv').set_index('station_id')\nw = pd.read_csv('weather_readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\nraw = r.pivot(index='timestamp', columns='station_id', values='current_reading').sort_index()\npiv = raw.interpolate(method='linear', limit_direction='both')\npollutant = r.groupby('station_id').pollutant.first()\nz = (piv - piv.mean())/piv.std()\nwd = w.groupby(['district','timestamp'])[['temperature_c','humidity_pct','wind_speed_m_s','rain_accumulation_mm']].mean()\n\nprint(\"missing counts:\", {st: int(raw[st].isna().sum()) for st in ['ST014','ST051','ST067','ST040','ST060','ST066','ST086']})\n\ndef peers_of(st,k=10):\n    cand=[c for c in piv.columns if c!=st and pollutant[c]==pollutant[st]]\n    cand.sort(key=lambda c: np.hypot((s.loc[st,'latitude']-s.loc[c,'latitude'])*111,(s.loc[st,'longitude']-s.loc[c,'longitude'])*70))\n    return cand[:k]\n\n# variance attribution: R2 of raw series on (peer pattern) vs (peer + wind)\nimport numpy.linalg as la\ndef r2(ycol, X):\n    X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(ycol))]+X)\n    beta,_,_,_ = la.lstsq(X1, ycol, rcond=None)\n    pred = X1@beta\n    return 1 - ((ycol-pred)**2).sum()/((ycol-ycol.mean())**2).sum()\n\nfor st in ['ST040','ST067','ST086','ST012','ST026']:\n    d=s.loc[st,'district']; wind=wd.loc[d,'wind_speed_m_s'].values\n    hum=wd.loc[d,'humidity_pct'].values; temp=wd.loc[d,'temperature_c'].values\n    ref=z[peers_of(st)].median(axis=1).values\n    y=z[st].values\n    print(f\"{st}: R2 peer={r2(y,[ref]):.3f}  peer+wind={r2(y,[ref,wind]):.3f}  wind_only={r2(y,[wind]):.3f}  hum_only={r2(y,[hum]):.3f}  temp_only={r2(y,[temp]):.3f}\")\n\n# how much of PEERS' own signal does wind explain (baseline physics)?\nfor d in ['STARE_MIASTO','PSIE_POLE','FABRYCZNA']:\n    wind=wd.loc[d,'wind_speed_m_s'].values\n    cols=[c for c in piv.columns if s.loc[c,'district']==d]\n    cors=[np.corrcoef(z[c],wind)[0,1] for c in cols]\n    print(f\"{d}: raw-series wind corr across stations: mean={np.mean(cors):.3f} min={min(cors):.3f} max={max(cors):.3f}\")\n    for st in ['ST040','ST067','ST086']:\n        if s.loc[st,'district']==d:\n            print(f\"   {st} raw wind corr: {np.corrcoef(z[st],wind)[0,1]:.3f}\")\n\n# ST014 lag robustness: only use originally-observed points\nx = raw['ST014']; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrifGbqa9GRcVbSRKx72","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015fBGxuV8wG4WYJUNtS8C1A","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nr = pd.read_csv('readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\ns = pd.read_csv('stations.csv').set_index('station_id')\nw = pd.read_csv('weather_readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\nws = pd.read_csv('weather_stations.csv').set_index('weather_station_id')\npiv = r.pivot(index='timestamp', columns='station_id', values='current_reading').sort_index().interpolate(method='linear', limit_direction='both')\npollutant = r.groupby('station_id').pollutant.first()\nz = (piv-piv.mean())/piv.std()\nwd = w.groupby(['district','timestamp'])[['temperature_c','humidity_pct','wind_speed_m_s','rain_accumulation_mm']].mean()\nwpiv = {v: w.pivot(index='timestamp', columns='weather_station_id', values=v).sort_index() for v in ['temperature_c','humidity_pct','wind_speed_m_s','rain_accumulation_mm']}\n\nprint(\"rain (district means, per timestep):\")\nprint(wd.reset_index().pivot(index='timestamp',columns='district',values='rain_accumulation_mm').round(2).T.to_string())\n\ndef peers_of(st,k=10):\n    cand=[c for c in piv.columns if c!=st and pollutant[c]==pollutant[st]]\n    cand.sort(key=lambda c: np.hypot((s.loc[st,'latitude']-s.loc[c,'latitude'])*111,(s.loc[st,'longitude']-s.loc[c,'longitude'])*70))\n    return cand[:k]\n\n# residual corr matrix, z-scored per weather variable across stations\nvars4=['temperature_c','humidity_pct','wind_speed_m_s','rain_accumulation_mm']\nC = pd.DataFrame(index=piv.columns, columns=vars4, dtype=float)\nfor st in piv.columns:\n    d=s.loc[st,'district']\n    resid = z[st].values - z[peers_of(st)].median(axis=1).values\n    for v in vars4:\n        C.loc[st,v]=np.corrcoef(resid, wd.loc[d,v].values)[0,1]\nZ = (C - C.mean())/C.std()\nprint(\"\\nper-variable outliers (|z of corr| > 2.8):\")\nfor v in vars4:\n    out = Z[v][Z[v].abs()>2.8]\n    print(v, {k: round(float(x),2) for k,x in out.items()}, \"| corr:\", {k: round(float(C.loc[k,v]),3) for k in out.index})\n\n# nearest weather station refinement for top candidates\ndef nearest_ws(st):\n    return min(ws.index, key=lambda q: np.hypot((s.loc[st,'latitude']-ws.loc[q,'latitude'])*111,(s.loc[st,'longitude']-ws.loc[q,'longitude'])*70))\nfor st in ['ST067','ST086','ST040','ST066']:\n    resid = z[st].values - z[peers_of(st)].median(axis=1).values\n    best=[]\n    for v in vars4:\n        for q in wpiv[v].columns:\n            c=np.corrcoef(resid, wpiv[v][q].values)[0,1]\n            best.append((abs(c),v,q,round(c,3)))\n    best.sort(reverse=True)\n    print(f\"\\n{st} nearest_ws={nearest_ws(st)} top residual couplings:\", best[:3])\nEOF","description":"Analyze rain structure and per-weather-station residual couplings"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2803,"cache_read_input_tokens":43582,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2803,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ea13913c-1056-4df6-8cf0-20322fc08591","uuid":"cb68d2b1-c213-4985-bd2e-9453fdb68666","request_id":"req_011CcrifFGyBQRVcJYsdFate"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrisyKt6aHhhMbVT6E36","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012VrPDV9v9a678WwC2QAtc9","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"\"\"\"Air-quality network audit: identify the 3 faulty stations.\n\nMethod\n------\nEach of the 100 stations reports one pollutant (PM25 or PM10) at 24 four-hourly\ntimestamps. Short gaps are linearly interpolated (preserving local time-series\nstructure). Every station is compared against a peer reference: the median\nz-scored series of its 10 nearest same-pollutant neighbours.\n\nThree distinct fault signatures are scored:\n\n1. Rhythm fault  -- station follows the local pattern but phase-shifted:\n   cross-correlation with the peer reference peaks at a non-zero lag\n   far above the lag-0 correlation.            -> ST014 (12h shift)\n\n2. Muted fault   -- plausible point-by-point (decent peer correlation,\n   matching mean) but amplitude of swings is far below comparable\n   local stations (std ratio ~0.59).           -> ST051\n\n3. Weather fault -- ordinary in aggregate (normal mean/std, good peer\n   correlation) yet residuals vs the peer reference correlate strongly\n   with exactly one environmental driver (wind speed, r = -0.66),\n   and only that driver.                       -> ST067\n\nNotes: rain_accumulation is cumulative (a time trend), so rain correlations\nare drift artifacts and are excluded as a \"driver\". ST040 shows the highest\nraw wind coupling but is a gross level outlier (mean ~170 vs ~34 for PM10\npeers, std 2.7x) and therefore not \"ordinary in aggregate\" -- a decoy.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\nDATA = \"/app/dataset\"\n\n\ndef answer() -> set[str]:\n    r = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/readings.csv\", parse_dates=[\"timestamp\"])\n    s = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/stations.csv\").set_index(\"station_id\")\n    w = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/weather_readings.csv\", parse_dates=[\"timestamp\"])\n\n    piv = (\n        r.pivot(index=\"timestamp\", columns=\"station_id\", values=\"current_reading\")\n        .sort_index()\n        .interpolate(method=\"linear\", limit_direction=\"both\")\n    )\n    pollutant = r.groupby(\"station_id\").pollutant.first()\n    z = (piv - piv.mean()) / piv.std()\n    # district-average weather; rain_accumulation is cumulative (trend) -> excluded\n    wd = w.groupby([\"district\", \"timestamp\"])[\n        [\"temperature_c\", \"humidity_pct\", \"wind_speed_m_s\"]\n    ].mean()\n\n    def peers_of(st, k=10):\n        cand = [c for c in piv.columns if c != st and pollutant[c] == pollutant[st]]\n        cand.sort(\n            key=lambda c: np.hypot(\n                (s.loc[st, \"latitude\"] - s.loc[c, \"latitude\"]) * 111,\n                (s.loc[st, \"longitude\"] - s.loc[c, \"longitude\"]) * 70,\n            )\n        )\n        return cand[:k]\n\n    rows = []\n    for st in piv.columns:\n        pcols = peers_of(st)\n        ref = z[pcols].median(axis=1)\n        x, y = z[st].values, ref.values\n\n        def corr_at(lag):\n            a, b = (x[lag:], y[:-lag]) if lag > 0 else ((x[:lag], y[-lag:]) if lag < 0 else (x, y))\n            return np.corrcoef(a, b)[0, 1]\n\n        corrs = {L: corr_at(L) for L in range(-4, 5)}\n        c0 = corrs[0]\n        lag_gain = max(corrs.values()) - c0\n        amp = piv[st].std() / piv[pcols].std().median()\n        mean_ratio = piv[st].mean() / piv[pcols].mean().median()\n\n        resid = x - y\n        d = s.loc[st, \"district\"]\n        wc = sorted(\n            (abs(np.corrcoef(resid, wd.loc[d, v].values)[0, 1]) for v in wd.columns),\n            reverse=True,\n        )\n        rows.append(\n            dict(st=st, c0=c0, lag_gain=lag_gain, amp=amp,\n                 mean_ratio=mean_ratio, wmax=wc[0], wsep=wc[0] - wc[1])\n        )\n    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index(\"st\")\n\n    # 1) rhythm: largest gain from shifting vs peers\n    rhythm = df.lag_gain.idxmax()\n\n    # 2) muted: lowest amplitude ratio among stations that still track peers\n    #    (plausible point-by-point: peer correlation above the median)\n    plausible = df[df.c0 > df.c0.median()]\n    muted = plausible.amp.idxmin()\n\n    # 3) weather-coupled: strongest single-driver residual correlation among\n    #    stations that are ordinary in aggregate (level and amplitude near peers)\n    ordinary = df[\n        (df.amp.between(0.7, 1.5))\n        & (df.mean_ratio.between(0.5, 2.0))\n        & (df.index != rhythm)\n        & (df.index != muted)\n    ]\n    weather = ordinary.wmax.idxmax()\n\n    return {rhythm, muted, weather}\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n\n    result = answer()\n    print(\"faulty stations:\", sorted(result))\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(result, f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7431,"cache_read_input_tokens":52769,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":7431,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ea13913c-1056-4df6-8cf0-20322fc08591","uuid":"8f3aac10-2052-41b1-adb0-a7af4b1fc70d","request_id":"req_011CcriswyXbbzvjKuXMEST1"}
